title: Work
description: One of the person's works, kept in a vault at <end>/<id>.json, where the folder (making, knowing or doing) is its end (Nicomachean Ethics VI.4; Metaphysics VI.1). Its section must be one of that end's. packages/core/src/works-by-end.ts reads and checks it.

section.description: Making: projects, products, writing, art, crafts. Knowing: research, study, reading. Doing: service, care, civic, talks, events.

disclosure.description: public goes out in full; foreshadow goes out as its end, section and one line only; private never goes out

problem.description: The problem the work addresses, in one sentence

cause.description: The problem's root cause, in one sentence

solution.description: The proposed solution, in one sentence

connector.description: The connector the work shows on, such as github, etsy, behance, substack, reading-list or calendar

sources.description: Where the work shows: the person's own connectors

status.description: How the work stands, from its sources' evidence where a source gives it

foreshadow.description: The one line shown for a foreshadowed work, without its name

pinned.description: Shown first in its section, whatever its status

href.description: A web address, or a path on the person's own site
